rows.text: converts `00267E10(r9)` to a float f, makes the call at `0034DEA0+0x23` with (`rdx`, f) and ends with the tail jump to `0025B470(rdx, f)`

reads three values a, b, c with `00267E10(r9)` in that order and makes the call at `00357570+0x46` with (c, b, a); when that returns null calls `0026B4E0(rcx, 0)`; otherwise calls `00262F50(rdx, result)` and, when it returns 0, calls `0026B4E0(rcx, 0)`, else calls `0026B4E0(rcx, 1)` and `0035AE10(result, 1)`

takes base b = qword `[rcx]` and off = `0020E600(dword b+0x68)`, makes the call at `003B7210+0x21`, and returns when off is 0 or dword `[b+off]` is not greater than 0 (signed); otherwise points at the word list at b + `0020E600(dword b+off+4)` and, for each index i below its leading word count, skips entries whose word `+2+i*2` is negative, and calls `00262F50(00358940(rcx, entry), q)` where q is qword `02EBCC68` for i = 0 (skipped when that qword is 0) and qword `[02EBCAC0 + (i-1)*8]` for i > 0 (skipped when i-1 is not below dword `02EBCBC0`, signed)

notes: 003B7210: the call at +0x21 receives no explicitly set argument registers (rcx is whatever 0020E600 left); its result is not used. The null test on off is on the full 64-bit result while the offset used is its sign-extended low dword.
